metadata.title: Cinelier
metadata.description: A film logbook with one note for each film, searchable by mood and by what you wrote.

brand.name: Cinelier
brand.tagline: Remember every film you have watched.

landing.headline: One note for every film you watch.
landing.lead: Write down what you thought, next to the date, a score, and the mood of the film. Your records stay private, and only you can read them.
landing.listAlt: A grid of posters for the films you have logged

features.title: A page for each film
features.text: Write what you thought after watching, with headings, lists, and quotes. Export your notes as Markdown at any time.

features.title: Find films by mood
features.text: Tag films as poignant, absurd or bitter ending, among 18 mood tags. Later, filter for the mood you are in tonight.

features.title: Search what you wrote
features.text: Search looks at your notes as well as titles, so you can find the film where you wrote about that one scene.

note.title: Your note, right next to the poster.
note.text: The note you wrote sits on the same page as the date and mood. You can also attach up to 10 photos of pamphlets or flyers to each film.
note.alt: One film's record, with a note of headings and text under the poster and the watched date

recommend.title: “Anything moving on Netflix?”
recommend.text: Love films, and people keep asking you what to watch. The right pick for someone else rarely comes to mind on the spot. Filter the films you have seen by platform and mood, and the answer is right there.
recommend.alt: Records filtered to the Netflix platform and the Moving mood

landing.closing: Start with the last film you saw. A title, the date, a score, and where you watched are all you need. You can add a note later.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use (the "Terms") set out the conditions for using Cinelier (the "Service") between the Cinelier operator (the "Operator") and its users. You must agree to these Terms to use the Service.

p: The Service is a personal log for films you have watched. You can save, list, search, edit and export records such as the watched date, score, notes and images.
Film information is searched through TMDB (The Movie Database).
The Service is provided free of charge.
To use the Service, you register with a display name, an email address and a password. Please enter accurate information.
You are responsible for keeping your password safe. Do not let anyone else use it.
Anything done through your account is treated as done by you.
You must not:
- break the law or public order;
- save or upload content that infringes the rights of others, such as copyright or privacy;
- interfere with the operation of the Service, for example by unauthorized access or excessive load;
- use another user's account without permission; or
- do anything else the Operator considers inappropriate.
You keep the rights to the records you save, such as notes and images.
With the current features, your records are not shown to other users.
The Operator handles your records only as needed to provide and maintain the Service and to respond to problems.
You confirm that you hold the necessary rights to any image you upload.
Film information comes from TMDB. The Service is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
We do not guarantee that the information is accurate or up to date.

sections.h: 6. Changes, suspension and end of the Service
p: The Operator may change, suspend or end the Service without prior notice.
If the Service ends, we will try to give notice beforehand.
You can delete your account at any time from the account settings.
When you do, your account and records are deleted and cannot be restored.
If you break these Terms, the Operator may suspend your use or delete your account without prior notice.
The Service is provided as is. We do not guarantee accuracy, continuity or that data will not be lost.
Except where the Operator acts intentionally or with gross negligence, the Operator is not liable for damages arising from your use of the Service.
We recommend keeping your own copy of records that matter to you. You can export your records from the account settings.
The Operator may change these Terms when needed.
Changes take effect when posted on the Service. Important changes will be announced on the Service.
These Terms are governed by Japanese law.
Japanese courts have jurisdiction as the court of first instance for any dispute about the Service.
For questions about the Service, please use the contact form below.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Cinelier operator (the "Operator") sets out below how it handles users' information in Cinelier (the "Service").

p: The Service collects the following.
- Account information: display name, email address, and password (stored in a form that cannot be turned back into the original text)
- Record information: title, original title, synopsis, release year, runtime, language, countries, genres, credits, watched date, platform, score, mood tags and note
- Poster images: the image URL you enter, or the image you upload
- Attached images: the images you upload to attach to a record, such as photos of pamphlets or flyers
- Contact information: the email address and message you enter in the contact form

- Support payment information: the name and email address you enter on the Stripe payment page, the amount you pay, and your card's brand, last 4 digits, expiry date and issuing country (we do not receive your full card number)
- Information used to keep you logged in
- Activity logs: access time, IP address, browser type, and your user ID when an error occurs
We use the information for:
- providing the Service (saving, showing, searching, editing and exporting records);
- logging in and verifying who you are;
- answering inquiries;
- confirming support payments;
- investigating and fixing problems;
- preventing abuse, such as limiting login attempts and blocking automated submissions of the login, sign-up, and contact forms; and
- dealing with violations of the Terms of Use.
Except where required by law, the Operator does not share the information with third parties without your consent.
However, to run the Service, the Operator may entrust the handling of information to the providers listed in "4. External services", only as far as needed.
The Service uses the following external services.
- TMDB (film search and information): the words you search for are sent from our server to TMDB. When TMDB poster images are shown, your IP address and browser information are sent to TMDB.
- Vercel (United States): the web server of the Service. Access logs are kept.
- Cloudflare Turnstile (United States): to block automated submissions of the login, sign-up, and contact forms, your IP address and browser information are sent to Cloudflare.
- Resend (United States): to deliver your inquiry to the Operator by email, the email address and message you enter are sent to Resend.
- Stripe (United States): to process support payments, Stripe handles the card number, email address and other details entered on its payment page. The Operator does not receive your card number.
We will add the provider and country of the server that stores account information, records, and uploaded images to this policy once it is decided.
Information on the personal data protection system of the United States is available on the website of Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission.
We do not use external services for advertising or analytics.
The Service uses cookies and local storage for:
- keeping you logged in (two cookies); and
- remembering your theme setting (light or dark) in your browser.
They are not used for advertising or tracking.
Account information and records are kept until you delete your account. When you do, your account information, records and uploaded images are deleted.
Contact information is kept as long as needed to answer the inquiry and deleted once it is no longer needed.
Records of support payments are kept by Stripe and are not deleted when you delete your account.
Activity logs are deleted after a set period.
The Operator works to prevent leaks, loss and damage of the information.
Passwords are stored in a form that cannot be turned back into the original text.
Communication with the Service is encrypted (HTTPS).
From the account settings, you can change your display name, email address and password, and delete your account (and with it your information).
For any other request, please use the contact form. We will respond after confirming your identity.
The Operator may change this policy when needed. Changes take effect when posted on the Service.
For questions about this policy, please use the contact form below.
